subject: Dried Fruit Studios is watching
body:
Hi. Your friendly neighborhood Deadpool here.

Craisin put me in your mailbox to explain the Marvel stuff and then told me I cant swear. Ants in this pack are literally portals to other dimensions but "f#@k" is where he draws the line?? Bullshorts. So whenever you see me write "forking" just know theres a dried cranberry reading over my shoulder.
